description: This file contains the implementation of the AttributeGroup controller class within the OpenCart admin module, handling actions such as listing, editing, and saving attribute groups for the catalog section of the platform.

classes.name: AttributeGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing attribute groups in the catalog section of OpenCart admin panel. Provides methods for listing, creating, editing, and saving attribute groups, and generating associated views.

classes.name: AttributeGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing attribute groups in the catalog section of OpenCart admin panel. Provides methods for listing, creating, editing, deleting attribute groups, and generating associated views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method that loads the attribute group listing page with necessary data and view rendering.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to show the list of attribute groups, setting up pagination, sorting, and passing data to the view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches a list of attribute groups from the model with applied filters, sorting, and pagination, then renders the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the attribute group form for adding or editing feature, pre-filling fields if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes POST data to add or update an attribute group, returning JSON response indicating success or errors.
